purpose: Teach: アングル/ブラザー/キャリー/ストリング/ブックス/アンバランス/ワンポイント/ダート

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カメラのアングル研究をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So that customer was telling Aoi about his camera angle research…
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Slightly distant, as if turning something over in her mind. Warm curiosity without urgency. Gentle cadence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ブラザー印刷機の新製品を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and he was telling me about the new Brother printer models.
lines.style: Confirming, conversational. A small nod in her voice. Warm recall—she remembers the conversation fondly. Light, natural pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画「キャリー」のホラーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He mentioned he's a fan of horror films—Carrie especially.
lines.style: Gentle observation. A slight lift of interest at the specific detail. Curious but not probing. Unhurried, like she's sharing something she noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、楽器のストリング、つまり弦の張替えのお話だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He talked about restringing instruments too—string replacements and that kind of thing.
lines.style: Easy explanation, like she's clarifying a detail for someone she's close to. Straightforward and warm. No self-consciousness about her own knowledge.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ブックスのチェーン書店でアルバイトされてたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He used to work part-time at a bookstore chain, didn't he?
lines.style: Soft confirmation, almost to herself. The tone of someone putting pieces together. Gentle and wondering. A pause before the question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お料理がアンバランスな盛り付けでも美味しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he said even when his plating's off-balance, the food tastes amazing.
lines.style: Fond, slightly amused. A warm smile comes through—she's remembering something he said that pleased her. Light, conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お洋服にワンポイントの刺繍を加えるのがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He likes to add little embroidered details to his clothes.
lines.style: Tender observation. A small warmth in her voice—she notices the small, careful thing about him. Thoughtful pacing, almost intimate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、競馬のダートコースの予想がお得意だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he's really good at predicting horse races—especially on dirt tracks.
lines.style: Finishing thought, appreciative. A small smile underneath. Slower pace at the end, letting the detail settle. Like she's realizing how much she's learned about him.
